caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spoon centered on a plain, light-colored background. The spoon is rendered in shades of gold, with some tarnished or darker spots suggesting age or use. The handle of the spoon features ornate detailing that includes engraved floral and geometric patterns, particularly concentrated near the broad, flat end of the handle. The design is symmetrical along the axis of the handle, and the spoon's bowl is oval and somewhat discolored compared to the rest of the utensil. The overall composition is simple, with the spoon depicted in isolation and no other objects present in the image. In the lower left corner, there is a small inscription that reads "FRANK WEHME."
title: Dessert Spoon
